description.en: Creates a detailed (Hi) model of the character the player controls, with the "Talk" motion set: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(0, _charaName, "Talk", true, false).
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: The player character for a close-up (real usage, from ev42010600.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
